column1: # Qamatz katan in common words of the Rambam and Tanya that the Torah/Tehillim edition does not contain in this form.
# Hand-checked nouns of the qotel/qotla pattern with a suffix (korban, chochma, koreach, tsorech, chotem, govah, kodesh).
# The qamatz before the first shva of each word is read "o". Prefixed forms (ו ב ל כ ה מ ש) are found automatically.
